items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: I’ll never forget Horowitz I believe it was

ctx.x: Very healthy and I keep practicing and try to make it less an agony pipe, and I’ll never forget Horowitz I believe it was, they said, “You’re 82 years old and you’re still practicing?” And he said, “I think I’m getting better.”
You know we don’t usually ask technical questions, but we may have a few clarinet players who might ask you about your instrument and the odd looking barrel—
